gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.
People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.
'Cause drowsiness' — the quality noun from drowsy.
'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.
'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: Much to everyone’s ___ (APPOINT), the open-air concert was cancelled.
gaps.explanation: 'To somebody’s disappointment' — the feeling noun follows the possessive.
